title: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
tagline: A murder mystery weekend, Greek island catering.

The Glass Onion BarGlass Onion: A Knives Out MysteryA murder mystery weekend, Greek island catering.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersGreek island mezzeHummus, tzatziki, olives, cherry tomatoes and warm pitaHow to make it400g chickpeas2 tbsp tahini1 garlic bulb1 lemon250g Greek yoghurt1 cucumber150g kalamata olives250g cherry tomatoes4 pita breadsBlitz the drained chickpeas with the tahini, the garlic clove, lemon and ice water until smooth.Mix the Greek yoghurt with half a grated cucumber, garlic and salt for tzatziki.Lay both out with the kalamata olives, cherry tomatoes and the warm pita breads.Disruptors' hot sauce wingsCrisp baked wings tossed in homemade red chilli and garlic sauceHow to make it1.2kg chicken wings2 tsp baking powder6 red chillies3 garlic cloves80ml white vinegar2 tbsp honey1 bunch celery150g blue cheese150g sour creamToss the chicken wings with the baking powder and salt and bake at 220°C for 45 minutes, turning once.Blitz the red chillies with the garlic cloves, the vinegar and the honey, simmer 5 minutes and toss through the wings.Serve with celery and the blue cheese stirred into the sour cream.Glass onion petals with whipped fetaThe giant glass onion at the centre of Miles Bron's islandHow to make itAs written, serves 4Red onions roasted until sweet, separated into glossy petals and filled with whipped feta, topped with honey, crushed pistachio and oregano.Heat the oven to 200°C.Halve 4 red onions through the root, keep the skins on, brush the cut sides with oil and roast cut side down for 30 minutes until soft.Cool, peel and separate into 20 to 24 petals.Blitz 200g feta with 80g Greek yoghurt, lemon zest and 1 tbsp oil until smooth.Spoon or pipe into each petal, drizzle with 2 tbsp honey and scatter with 30g crushed pistachios and dried oregano.MainsPuzzle box lamb souvlakiLemon, garlic and oregano lamb skewers grilled and served in pitaHow to make it800g lamb leg1 lemon1 garlic bulb2 tsp dried oregano4 pita breads250g Greek yoghurt1 cucumber2 tomatoes1 red onionCut the lamb leg into cubes and marinate 2 hours with the juice of the lemon, the garlic cloves, the dried oregano and the oil.Thread onto skewers and grill 8 minutes, turning.Serve in the warm pitas with the Greek yoghurt mixed with grated cucumber, plus tomato and onion.Chargrilled octopus with lemon potatoesA Greek seaside lunch on Miles Bron's islandHow to make itAs written, serves 4Octopus simmered until tender, charred hard on the grill and dressed in lemon, oregano and olive oil, with crispy lemon potatoes, capers and red onion.Simmer 1.2kg cleaned octopus in salted water with a bay leaf for 50 minutes until tender, then cool in the liquid.Heat the oven to 220°C.Toss 800g halved chat potatoes with oil, the juice of 1 lemon and oregano and roast 40 minutes.Cut the octopus into legs, oil and char on a very hot grill 2 minutes a side.Toss with the potatoes, 1 tbsp capers, sliced red onion, lemon juice, olive oil and parsley.SweetsDuke's pineapple upside-down cakeButtery sponge baked over caramelised pineapple rings and cherriesHow to make it185g butter100g brown sugar440g tin pineapple rings8 glacé cherries150g caster sugar2 eggsvanilla extract, to taste200g self-raising flour125ml milk300ml thickened creamHeat the oven to 180°C.Melt the butter with the brown sugar in a 23cm cake tin and lay the pineapple rings on top with a glacé cherry in the middle of each.Beat the soft butter with the caster sugar, add the eggs and the vanilla, then fold in the self-raising flour and the milk.Spread over the fruit and bake 45 minutes.Rest 5 minutes, turn out and serve warm with whipped cream.DrinksAlpha poolside spiked kombuchaGinger kombucha with vodka, mint and lime over iceHow to make it1 L ginger kombucha2 limes1 bunch mint120ml vodkaFill the tall glasses with ice, mint leaves and a squeeze of lime.Pour the cold ginger kombucha into each and add the vodka to the glasses of anyone who wants it spiked.Stir once and serve straight away.Aperol spritzBirdie's poolside order, sunglasses on.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
